title.en: Does Diesel 40 cover rural and infrastructure work, read as separate catalogue cells
title.zh: 柴油40覆盖农村和基建吗，各格分开读

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Yes, as those published sentences, inside 120 m / 360 m. Taken from the printed row: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 40 at 4108 diesel 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 112, 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm and 2800 kg. Keep this cell as published. The introduction pairs 120 m / 360 m with 1 cm aggregate. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. There is no separate maximum-aggregate cell. Read it in the Xingtai table. It is not the 17 kW rural house pump and not the tractor-driven 4100.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：可以，按那些已公布的句子，并且停在 120 m / 360 m 内。邢台河北品锦机械把柴油40印成 4108 柴油机 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、川崎 112、外形 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm、2800 kg。产品介绍把 120 m / 360 m 和 1 cm 骨料写在一起。没有单独的最大骨料格。它不是 17 kW 的农村住宅泵，也不是拖拉机带动4100。

body.en: “Magneto and mechanical systems” is an outline label from “Ignition system”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Read it in the Xingtai table. The page says yes: no stable grid, rural and infrastructure placement. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 40 at 4108 diesel 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 112, 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm and 2800 kg. Keep this cell as published. It is not the 17 kW rural house pump and not the tractor-driven 4100. Taken from the printed row: Use it when the infrastructure or rural line needs the 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m window and the site has no stable grid. Read it in the Xingtai table. The distance pair looks similar and the output does not: 21 versus 26 m³/h. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Say whether the job is the compact 17 kW house or the 66 kW trailer window. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. Taken from the printed row: No. Read it in the Xingtai table. The cell is 120 m / 360 m, horizontal / vertical. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ignition_system
body.zh: “力学系统”是《Ignition system》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。按邢台表上的原文理解：产品页写了：电网不便、农村与基建浇筑。格子是 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、120 m / 360 m，产品介绍里有 1 cm 骨料。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动40印的是 45 kW、21 m³/h、细石 120 m / 360 m。距离看起来接近，输送量不是：21 对 26 m³/h。选型指南让你先定动力。不要把柴油40介绍里的 1 cm 抄到电动40的细石行和 13 骨料行上。这一格照已印出的读：不是。4100 是单独的拖拉机带动页：40 kW、6–12 m³/h、1300 kg。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ignition_system

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Electronic systems” from “Ignition system”, then stays with the cells already published. Taken from the printed row: Cells are 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa and 120 m / 360 m, with 1 cm aggregate in the introduction. Read it in the Xingtai table. The introduction pairs 120 m / 360 m with 1 cm aggregate. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The compact rural diesel prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical, aggregate 1–3 cm and 800 kg, and its name is the self-built house pump. Keep this cell as published. A house that fits the 17 kW window should stay there. Taken from the printed row: The selection guide tells you to choose power type first. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Keep this cell as published. Only the introduction mentions 1 cm aggregate with the distance.
body.zh: 本节保留《Ignition system》的标题“系统”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。可以，按那些已公布的句子，并且停在 120 m / 360 m 内。河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油40印成 4108 柴油机 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、川崎 112、外形 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm、2800 kg。产品介绍把 120 m / 360 m 和 1 cm 骨料写在一起。没有单独的最大骨料格。它不是 17 kW 的农村住宅泵，也不是拖拉机带动4100。按邢台表上的原文理解：请说明工况是紧凑的 17 kW 住宅，还是 66 kW 拖泵窗口。旁边那一台不在这句话里。没有。只有产品介绍在距离旁边提到 1 cm 骨料。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Gas turbine and rocket engines” in “Ignition system”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Keep this cell as published. Yes, as those published sentences, inside 120 m / 360 m. Taken from the printed row: There is no separate maximum-aggregate cell. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 40 is a 2800 kg trailer. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h and fine stone 120 m / 360 m. Keep this cell as published. Do not copy Diesel 40’s 1 cm introduction note onto Electric 40’s fine-stone and aggregate-13 rows. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. The 4100 is a separate tractor-driven page at 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h and 1300 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Headings already printed: On a grid, Electric 40 is the medium-building neighbour
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Ignition system》的“气体发动机”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。这一格照已印出的读：紧凑农村柴油泵印的是 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、骨料 1–3 cm、800 kg，产品名就是自建房泵。柴油40是 2800 kg 的拖泵。基建或农村管路需要 26 m³/h 和 120 m / 360 m、现场又没有稳定电网时，用它。落在 17 kW 窗口里的住宅应留在那一页。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。格子是水平/垂直 120 m / 360 m。已印出的标题：有电网时，电动40是中型建筑的邻居

question.en: “Magneto and mechanical systems” does not change the check: Is Diesel 40 the tractor 4100?
question.zh: “力学系统”不改这一问：柴油40是拖拉机4100吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. The 4100 is a separate tractor-driven page at 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h and 1300 kg.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。4100 是单独的拖拉机带动页：40 kW、6–12 m³/h、1300 kg。

question.en: Does the table print maximum aggregate, once the outline says “Electronic systems”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“系统”时，表里印了最大骨料吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No. Only the introduction mentions 1 cm aggregate with the distance.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：没有。只有产品介绍在距离旁边提到 1 cm 骨料。

question.en: Under “Gas turbine and rocket engines”, is 360 m horizontal?
question.zh: 在“气体发动机”这一节里，360 m 是水平吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No. The cell is 120 m / 360 m, horizontal / vertical.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：不是。格子是水平/垂直 120 m / 360 m。
